details: Invalid as stated.  If the rows are the concepts of an $N\times N$ Hadamard sign matrix, then $|\mathcal H|=N$ but its sign rank is at least $\sqrt N$.
proof: Interpret the rows of an $N\times N$ Hadamard matrix as concepts on its $N$ columns.  Forster's spectral lower bound gives sign rank at least $\sqrt N$.  For arbitrarily large powers of two, $\sqrt N>\log_2N$, contradicting the displayed inequality.
name: Log Size / Sign Rank
